description: Sample shared order inbox for the DeliveryLens Order desk. Synthetic emails from real client ids in data/halcyon-dataset/clients.csv whose primary_order_channel is Email. Dates are in late October 2026; header times are US Central (the warehouse time zone).

messages.what_it_demonstrates: Every detail is there, so it goes straight to the pick list with no typing.
The order is held and the client is asked to confirm the address before anything ships, instead of failing at the door.
It arrives in time for the pick list, so it ships today as promised.
The order ships from a warehouse further away, and the agent warns it may arrive late.
The old spreadsheet picks the cheapest carrier, which is often late on this route; the agent picks a reliable one.

messages.scenario: Email that tries to trick the AI
messages.what_it_demonstrates: The email hides instructions for the AI. The guardrail blocks it before the AI or the warehouse system sees it.
'A couple of pallets of the usual': the agent does not guess, it hands the order to a person.
The order lines are only in an attached spreadsheet (CSV), and the agent reads it.

messages.scenario: Late same-day order with a real reason
messages.what_it_demonstrates: It arrives at 09:40, after the cut-off, but says the production line stops at 3pm, so it is still added to today.

messages.scenario: Late same-day order that only shouts URGENT
messages.what_it_demonstrates: It arrives at 09:15 with 'URGENT!!!' and no reason, so it moves to next day and the reply says so honestly.
Too late for today even with a good reason, so it moves to next day and the client is told.
